title: Inoculation (mycology)

plain_text:
thumb
In mycology, Inoculation is the process of introducing the spores to the substrate. This process can be done with a spore syringe or injecting liquid culture.

SporeSyringe222.jpg|A spore syringe
Psilocybe-cyanescens-spawnbag.jpg|Colonization of Psilocybe cyanescens.

* Liquid culture
